summary: Phase-2 testing of new Pulse Anketi category. Backend: 23/23 pytest pass (12 pre-existing + 11 new pulse tests covering seed, list with response_rate, 1-5 question validation on POST & PUT, feed audience filtering + filled flag, respond persistence, anonymous report gating (persons[] empty + comments as 'Anonim'), non-anonymous report structure (company trend, org_units, persons, distribution), my-history employee-scoped). Frontend: verified employee flow end-to-end — discovery grid renders 2 active cards (Duyurular + Pulse Anketi) with Doldurulmadı/Dolduruldu preview badges, mandatory banner + CTA navigate to fill, fill screen shows 5 emoji faces (skor) + radios (tek_secim) + optional comment textareas, validation toast on empty submit, thank-you screen after valid submit, feed badge flips to Dolduruldu, history dialog shows personal line chart. Admin flow: third tab 'Pulse Anketleri' renders (after fixing missing import — see updated_files), list shows response rate 62% (5/8) for seeded pulse, report has Şirket line chart, Organizasyon Birimi bar chart, Kişi Bazlı table with 10 person rows; MAX_Q=5 add-button disables at 5 with warning; creating an anonymous pulse hides the Kişi tab entirely (verified). Announcements from prior phase still working (smoke via pytest).

ui_bugs.issue: Banner does not refresh after the employee submits a mandatory pulse. It stays visible with 'Şimdi Doldur' CTA even though the feed badge already flipped to Dolduruldu. Root cause: useEffect deps are only [role, currentEmployeeId]; there is no event/refresh trigger after api.respondPulse. Needs a bus/refresh key (e.g., listen for pulseSubmitted event, or include location.pathname / a global refresh counter in deps) so the banner re-queries /api/pulses/feed after fill.

action_items: Refresh MandatoryPulseBanner after a successful pulse submission (e.g., emit a window event 'pulse:submitted' in PulseFill.submit() and listen for it in the banner, or wire a shared refresh counter via AppContext).
(Optional) Persist role/currentEmployeeId in localStorage — page.goto/reload currently resets role to 'employee' which surprised testing and could confuse real users returning via bookmarks.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.js originally referenced <PulsesManager /> but did NOT import it, and TABS array had no 'pulse' entry — the third admin tab was unreachable. Fixed by test agent (added import + TABS entry). Main agent should keep this fix.
MandatoryPulseBanner state stale after submit (see UI bug).
AppContext role/currentEmployeeId are in-memory only; a full page reload resets to default employee. Consider persisting to localStorage.

PulsesManager save() uses object destructuring to strip fields but does not strip 'response_count', 'response_rate', 'target_count' when editing — PUT payload will include those. Backend ignores unknown fields via Pydantic exclude_none but PulseUpdate is strict Optional — extra keys are silently accepted since Pydantic v2 default is 'ignore'. Non-blocking but worth cleaning.

rca of the issue: MandatoryPulseBanner useEffect deps are [role, currentEmployeeId]. After a mandatory pulse is submitted via POST /api/pulses/{id}/respond, no re-render trigger exists to re-run the effect and refetch /api/pulses/feed, so `pending` state remains the pre-fill value. Fix options: (1) window event dispatch from PulseFill.submit() + listener in banner, (2) shared context refresh counter incremented on any pulse action, (3) React Query with query invalidation.
